bullets.text: Residents blocked the Chennai-Tirupati road near Periyapalayam for thirty minutes protesting a five-hour power outage, and the office should monitor district power supply stability.

stories.title: பெரியபாளையம் அருகே 5 மணிநேரம் மின்வெட்டு கண்டித்து சாலை மறியல்
takeaways: Public blocked the Chennai Tirupati highway near Periyapalayam for thirty minutes demanding restoration after prolonged power outages.
District officials must address persistent electricity disruptions in Thiruvallur to prevent further traffic blockades and public unrest.

stories.title: LiveX Brings Physical AI to Airports, Hospitals and Stores With the Launch of AI City
takeaways: LiveX and NVIDIA launched AI City at the Smart City Expo World Congress in Barcelona.
The new platform introduces physical artificial intelligence applications for airports, hospitals, and retail stores.
